description: filter: blur() applied to a box with a solid background-color fill.
filter: blur() applied to an raster; blur of image rasters is the implemented path.
filter: brightness(1.6) lightening a four-quadrant color image.
filter: contrast(2) increasing contrast of a four-quadrant color image.
filter: grayscale(1) fully desaturating a four-quadrant color image.
filter: sepia(1) applying a sepia tone to a four-quadrant color image.
filter: saturate(3) boosting saturation of a four-quadrant color image.
filter: hue-rotate(120deg) rotating the hue of a four-quadrant color image.
filter: invert(1) inverting the colors of a four-quadrant color image.
filter: opacity(0.5) compositing a red box over a grey backdrop; distinct from the opacity property.
filter: drop-shadow() casting a hard offset shadow that traces a non-rectangular (diamond) image alpha, not its bounding box.
filter: url(#id) referencing an inline SVG feColorMatrix saturate filter (aspirational).
Chained filter functions blur(4px) brightness(1.5); parser matches only a single blur() so the chain is unsupported.
filter: blur() on a bordered solid box: should soften both fill and border edge, contrasting with the img-raster blur path.
filter: grayscale(1) applies to a parent source graphic including colored text and a child box; catches implementations that recolor only the parent background or ignore descendants.
contrast(5) blur(8px) and blur(8px) contrast(5) produce different edge softness; catches implementations that reorder filter functions.
drop-shadow() without a color uses currentColor for the shadow; catches parsers that default the omitted color to black.
filter:url(#id) references an inline SVG feGaussianBlur primitive; catches URL-filter implementations limited to feColorMatrix or no-op filters.

feature: filter value grammar with an unknown function
description: Invalid filter functions must invalidate the whole declaration: A red block has filter: blur(8px) bogus(1); the whole declaration is invalid so it remains crisp. Catches wrong implementation: Parser ignores bogus(1) and still applies blur(8px).

Unresolved filter url() must ignore the entire filter chain: A filter list starts with an unresolved url(#missing) followed by blur(7px); the whole chain is ignored. Catches wrong implementation: Implementation treats the missing url as a no-op and still applies the later blur.

feature: filter: blur() on a container group
description: blur() must apply to the whole element subtree: A container with a blue background, a yellow child, and text is blurred as one source graphic. Catches wrong implementation: Only the container background is blurred, leaving child paint and glyphs crisp.

blur() visual overflow must paint outside the border box without moving layout: A blurred red square sits next to a green square; blur feathers extend left/right but the green square keeps its fixed position. Catches wrong implementation: Renderer clips the blur to the red border box or expands layout and shifts the green square.

blur() on text glyphs needs raster/filter coverage: Large text with filter: blur(3px) should render as softened glyph shapes. Catches wrong implementation: Text remains vector-crisp while only surrounding box paint changes or no blur is applied.

feature: filter: brightness() on a container group
description: brightness() must filter descendant text and child paint: A container with a solid background, child chip, and glyphs uses filter:brightness(180%); all descendants are part of the filtered source graphic. Catches wrong implementation: Implementation applies the color operation only to the box fill/image path and leaves descendants unfiltered.

feature: filter: contrast() on a container group
description: contrast() must filter descendant text and child paint: A container with a solid background, child chip, and glyphs uses filter:contrast(220%); all descendants are part of the filtered source graphic. Catches wrong implementation: Implementation applies the color operation only to the box fill/image path and leaves descendants unfiltered.

feature: filter: hue-rotate() on a container group
description: hue-rotate() must filter descendant text and child paint: A container with a solid background, child chip, and glyphs uses filter:hue-rotate(120deg); all descendants are part of the filtered source graphic. feature: filter: invert() on a container group
description: invert() must filter descendant text and child paint: A container with a solid background, child chip, and glyphs uses filter:invert(100%); all descendants are part of the filtered source graphic. Catches wrong implementation: Implementation applies the color operation only to the box fill/image path and leaves descendants unfiltered.

drop-shadow() must obey authored chain position: A dark drop shadow is followed by brightness(2); the shadow itself should be brightened because later filter functions consume the prior output. Catches wrong implementation: Renderer always applies color functions to the source before computing drop-shadow, leaving the shadow dark.

feature: filter: drop-shadow() on rounded CSS box alpha
description: drop-shadow() on CSS boxes follows the alpha shape, not a rectangular box-shadow: A circular red element casts a zero-blur drop-shadow; the shadow should be circular because it is based on source alpha. Catches wrong implementation: Implementation treats it like a rectangular box-shadow or only supports drop-shadow on replaced images.

drop-shadow() accepts color before the lengths: The color token appears first in drop-shadow(#00695c 36px 0 0); grammar allows color and lengths in any order. Catches wrong implementation: Parser only accepts color after the lengths and drops the authored teal shadow.

feature: filter: url(#id) with feColorMatrix type=matrix channel swap
description: SVG feColorMatrix arbitrary matrices must be honored: An inline SVG filter referenced from CSS contains a non-feColorMatrix primitive or unsupported matrix form. Catches wrong implementation: CSS filter:url() resolver extracts only a narrow feColorMatrix subset and skips the primitive.

feature: filter: url(#id) with feTurbulence and feDisplacementMap
description: Procedural SVG filter primitives must affect static output: An inline SVG filter referenced from CSS contains a non-feColorMatrix primitive or unsupported matrix form. Catches wrong implementation: CSS filter:url() resolver extracts only a narrow feColorMatrix subset and skips the primitive.

color-interpolation-filters must switch SVG filter color space: Two identical muted boxes use feColorMatrix saturate(0); one filter defaults to linearRGB and one explicitly uses sRGB, producing different grays. Catches wrong implementation: Implementation ignores color-interpolation-filters and produces identical gray boxes.

backdrop-filter blur must sample content behind the element: A translucent panel overlays hard vertical stripes; backdrop-filter: blur(8px) should smear the stripes under the panel only. Catches wrong implementation: Renderer treats backdrop-filter as unsupported or applies normal filter to the panel itself.

filter must be applied before clip-path: A blurred red square is clipped to a circle; the blur is first computed then the circular clip removes all outside-circle paint. Catches wrong implementation: Renderer clips first and then blurs, creating a red feather outside the circular clip.

filter must be applied before mask-image: A blurred red rectangle is masked by a hard half-plane gradient; blur is computed before the mask clips the right half. Catches wrong implementation: Renderer masks first and then blurs, bleeding red into the transparent half.

filter-created stacking contexts must contain negative z-index descendants: A filtered parent contains a negative z-index child and sits on a gray page; the child cannot escape behind outside content. Catches wrong implementation: Renderer applies filter paint but does not create a stacking context, letting the child paint behind the page/sibling order incorrectly.
